utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got 14 Maple and a 4:30 departure noted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you — I’ve got that noted. Next I’ll use 14 Maple as the starting point and keep the repair drive moving from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Rosa — that keeps the repair drive route tidy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still catching up, so could you remind me what’s already been decided and what we should do first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — a few neighbors are already pitching in, and supplies are being gathered. First thing, come by and I’ll point you to the collection spot and get you looped in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll come by and get looped in at the collection spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll bring the list and whatever supplies I’ve got on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. Just bring the list over and I’ll start sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll bring it over and we can sort out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still checking what needs fixing and what time it starts. Once I know, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll just verify the time and place for now, and let me know the rest when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — that helps a lot. I’ll check what still needs fixing and get back to you as soon as I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — just let me know the time as soon as you have it, and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — it’s 3 p.m. at the community center. Thanks for working around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — 3 p.m. at the community center works for me, and I’ll plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going pretty well so far — folks have been dropping off things to fix, and I’ve been lending out a few tools to keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s a good sign, Gus. Could you point me to the list of repairs so I can see who needs help first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got the repair list here, and I can point out the ones that need help first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—I’ll check back later today. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll keep sorting the supplies and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and check back later today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll head over later and start at the blue canopy by the community hall. Then I’ll check in and drop off what I brought.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along and keep everyone posted if anything changes. Thanks for helping out at the blue canopy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll stick to the plan and check back after I’ve dropped everything off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — if you’re headed over, just check in at the blue canopy by the community hall. They’re sorting supplies there, and I’m sure they could use another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll check in at the blue canopy and help sort supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — let’s pin down the time and who’s bringing what before anyone heads out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check the timing before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’d feel better if we also confirm who’s bringing what before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, I’m a bit late — what’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly sorting the donated items and setting them by category. If you can help with that, I’ll text you the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can help sort the donations by category. Send me the details and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3 p.m. over by the community center — I’ll be there a little early if you want to come with me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can meet you there around 3.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll see you there around 3.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re still on track, as far as I know. I’ll check in later today for the next clear update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help with the boxes out front and then check the pickup list too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll keep to the plan and check back once we have a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks—just let me know the time as soon as it’s set, and I’ll work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — just text me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll text you as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll text you the time, place, and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Leo — thanks. Text me the details and I’ll be there with a few tools to lend out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the time, place, and a quick list of tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and set aside anything that’s still in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Sam — thank you. I’ll keep the priority list moving, and you can sort the tools while I check who needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll sort the tools now and set aside the ones in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll check the date, time, and place first, and then I’ll let you know if anything else looks off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. If anything looks off, could you also note it beside the priority list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll note any issues beside the priority list and double-check the date, time, and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful — I’ll make sure everyone knows you’re coming with supplies, Cleo. We’ll be glad to have you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll put together that quick supply list and bring it by. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word so more neighbors can join in at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m free now—let’s start with the timing and then sort out who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — can we confirm the time first, then make a quick list of who’s bringing each item?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—what time works best for everyone? After that, I’ll note who’s bringing each item.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, I’ll check back later today. Thanks for keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just want to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, that’s my understanding too — it’s still happening today. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s still on track — I’m just making sure everyone’s got the plan, and I’ll pass along any updates if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — thanks, Vik. If anything shifts, just send me the update and I’ll pass it along to the neighborhood groups.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes and make sure the neighborhood groups hear the update too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Tess — I’m still checking what needs fixing and the timing. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Oren — just let me know when you’ve got the list and timing, and I’ll help point folks to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a big help. I’ll check it over and get back to you once I know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3 p.m. over by the community center — I’ll be there a little early if you want to come with me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — I can come with you and help set up a bit early.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll meet you a little before 3 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note next Saturday at the community center by the school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’m still catching up, so what’s the first thing we need to do next for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: First I’ll confirm the repair-drive route and list who’s starting where, so everything stays tidy. If you’ve got any other locations or timing updates, send them my way.
